questions.question: 'Praise' is related to 'Condemn' in the same way as 'Lazy' is related to '_______'.
questions.solution:

Similarly, the Antonym(Opposite) of 'Lazy' is 'Industrious'.

Hence, **'Lazy' is related to 'Industrious'** in the same way as 'Praise' is related to 'Condemn'.

questions.question: In a code language, If STIMULI is written as 7 INFORMATION is written as 11, then how will GRANULES be written in the same language?
questions.solution:
Logic: Here, every word is coded as the number of letters in that word.

⇒ In the word 'STIMULI', there are 7 letters. So, code is 7.

⇒ In the word 'INFORMATION', there are 11 letters. So, code is 11.

* So, the code for the word 'GRANULES' is 8 as there are 8 letters in this word.

Thus, GRANULES will be written as **8**.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly know facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All wires are motors.

All motors are pumps.

**Conclusions:**

i. All wires are pumps.

ii. Some motors are wires.

options.text: Either conclusion i or ii follows
Both the conclusions i and ii follow

questions.solution:
The possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5a98da3367b6a34d09c0ee101bdc9432f1dcf476fe95c9de8a7a0239395362b.png] 

Conclusions:

i. All wires are pumps.→ True(As all wires are motors and all motors are pumps, imply that all wires are pumps.)

ii. Some motors are wires.→ True (As All wires are motors. So, some motors are definitely wires.) 

Thus,** both conclusions i and ii follows**.

questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangements of the following words in a logical order.

i. Century

ii. Month

iii. Year

iv. Decade

v. Millennium
questions.solution:
Logic: All the given words are used to denote a set period of time. So, Arrangement of the given words can be done in two ways-

1. From the longest to the smallest. OR 2. From the smallest to the longest.

** Meaning of the given words**

i. Century: A period of 100 years.

ii. Month: A period of four weeks or approximately 30 days.

iii. Year: A period of 12 months.

iv. Decade: A period of 10 years.

v. Millennium: A period of 1000 years.

So, based on the meaning, the two arrangements can be:

1. From the longest to the smallest → Millennium(v), Century(i), Decade(iv), Year(iii), Month(ii).

2. From the smallest to the longest → Month(ii), Year(iii), Decade(iv), Century(i), Millennium(v).

From these two, only one arrangement is given in the options. And that is- Millennium(v), Century(i), Decade(iv), Year(iii), Month(ii)

Therefore, **(v, i, iv, iii, ii)**- is the correct arrangement.

questions.question: In a code language, SAME is written as SMEA. How will FLOW be written in that language?
questions.solution:

Logic: SAME is coded as SMEA by arranging the letters of the word 'SAME' in decreasing order of their numerical position in alphabetic order-

S → 19th position

A → 1st position

M → 13th position.

E → 5th position.

Decreasing order of 19, 1, 13, 4 is → 19, 13, 4, 1.

So, SAME is coded as- S(19) M(13) E(5) A(1)

By the same logic, FLOW will be coded as-

F → 6th position

L → 12th position

O → 15th position

W → 23rd position.

Decreasing order of 6, 12, 15, 23 is → 23, 15, 12, 6.

So, FLOW will be coded as W(23) O(15) L(12) F(6)

Hence, **FLOW should be written as WOLF**.

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

51 - 4 × 7 + 81 ÷ 3 = 70
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 51 - 4 × 7 + 81 ÷ 3 = 70 

__CONCEPT:__

Follow the BODMAS rule to solve this question interchanging the respective numbers given in each option, as per the order given below,

Step - 1 - Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first,

Step - 2 - Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' should be solved next,

Step - 3 - Then, the parts of the equation containing 'Division' and 'Multiplication' operations are solved,

Step - 4 - And lastly, the parts of the equation that contains 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

So, on using BODMAS and solving each option, 

1) 7 and 51,

After interchanging, the equation becomes,

7 - 4 × 51 + 81 ÷ 3 = 70

7 - 4 × 51 + 27 = 70

7 - 204 + 27 = 70

- 170 ≠ 70

2) 3 and 4

After interchanging, the equation becomes,

51 - 3 × 7 + 81 ÷ 4 = 70 

51 - 3 × 7 + 20.25 = 70

51 - 21 + 20.25 = 70

50.25 ≠ 70

3) 51 and 3

After interchanging, the equation becomes,

3 - 4 × 7 + 81 ÷ 51 = 70 

3 - 4 × 7 + 1.59 = 70

3 - 28 + 1.59 = 70

-23.41 ≠ 70

4) 51 and 81

After interchanging, the equation becomes,

81 - 4 × 7 + 51 ÷ 3 = 70 

81 - 4 × 7 + 17 = 70

81 - 28 + 17 = 70

98 - 28 = 70

70 = 70

Hence, **51 and 81** should be interchanged to make the given equation correct.

questions.question: In a code language, if INTERVAL is written as 914205952615, then how will RESPONSE be written in the same language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aefcd090e4721ab168474cd72dc7f0a88835716ce3c569f68482016e79ea81ae.png] 

Logic: The first four letters of the given word are coded for their respective numerical position in alphabetical order and the last four letters of the given word are coded as for their respective numerical position in reverse alphabetical order.

This means,

The first four letters of the word INTERVAL (I, N, T, E) are coded as → I = 9, N = 14, T = 20, E = 5 (All in alphabetical order)

And the last four letters of the word INTERVAL (R, V, A, L) are coded as → R = 9, V = 5, A = 26, L = 15 (All in reverse alphabetical order)

Combining these, the complete code → 914205952615 is obtained.

Similarly, RESPONSE would be coded as-

The first four letters → R = 18, E = 5, S = 19, P = 16

And the last four letters → O = 12, N = 13, S = 8, E = 22

Combining these, the complete code → 18519161213822 is obtained.

Thus, RESPONSE will be written as **18519161213822**.
